source_row.rationale: Precautions for a client with known esophageal varices include avoiding activities that increase intra-abdominal or portal pressure (such as straining or vigorous coughing), and monitoring closely for any signs of GI bleeding, given the life-threatening risk if a varix ruptures.
source_row.source_detail: Precautions to Reduce Variceal Bleeding Risk
